name: Francis
source:
Francis is probably the most quiet of the Roachrists and prefers spending time in the library reading. He’s very smart, a hard worker and he also gets bossed around by his older sister (Vivi). Francis and his sister are also the only two characters who originally come from Luche.

(from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/07/10/kago-no-naka-no-alicis-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url])
